name: 内容创作辅助插件
description: 协助撰写高质量内容，覆盖起草、增强、审阅三大阶段七个场景

displayDescription.en: Full-chain content creation assistant covering drafting, enhancement, and review across seven scenes.
displayDescription.zh: 从材料启动到成稿收口的全链路内容创作辅助，覆盖起草、增强、审阅三大阶段七个场景。

defaultInitInput.zh: 帮我分析以下材料，判断文档类型，搭建结构并写出开篇正文
defaultInitInput.en: Analyze the following materials, determine document type, build structure, and write the opening passage

quickInputs.en: Analyze the following materials, determine document type, build structure, and write the opening passage
quickInputs.zh: 帮我分析以下材料，判断文档类型，搭建结构并写出开篇正文

quickInputs.en: Supplement research and citations for my draft, and polish the text
quickInputs.zh: 为我的文稿补充调研引用并润色文本

quickInputs.en: Review my draft paragraph by paragraph and give revision feedback
quickInputs.zh: 逐段审阅我的文稿并给出修改反馈

displayDescription.en: Export structured documents with TOC, citation list, and metadata to formatted Markdown files.
displayDescription.zh: 将结构化文档导出为带目录、引用列表和元数据的格式化 Markdown 文件。

displayDescription.en: Format citation entries according to GB/T 7714, APA, MLA, or simple inline styles.
displayDescription.zh: 按 GB/T 7714、APA、MLA 或简洁行内格式标准化引用条目。
